---
title: "Roadmap"
description: "What works today, what's experimental, and what's next."
---

Storywell is alpha software (`0.1.0a0`). The Audible → StoryGraph path is solid; the multi-source
layer now spans eleven vendors — three battle-tested, the rest
[newly added](sources.qmd#newly-added-sources) and best run with `--dry-run` first.

## Done

- [x] Audible → StoryGraph: list, match, mark-as-read with finish dates
- [x] Multi-source architecture (`--source`, pluggable provider registry, ISBN-first matching)
- [x] Goodreads, Kobo, Calibre sources
- [x] LibraryThing, Hardcover sources — _experimental_
- [x] Literal, Apple Books, Bookwyrm, Libby, Kindle sources — _newly added_
- [x] Ratings & reviews sync (with narrator note)
- [x] Audio-edition tagging (audiobook sources mark the audio edition)
- [x] Idempotent, interruption-safe sync keyed by `source:id`
- [x] Cross-source de-duplication (one StoryGraph write when two sources share a book)
- [x] Shelf routing — file books on `to-read` / `currently-reading` / `did-not-finish`, not just `read`

## Next

- [ ] Harden the new sources against more real exports / a live Hardcover token
- [ ] Evaluate [Google Play Books and Spotify audiobooks](sources.qmd#unsupported) (one feasibility test each)
- [ ] Audio-edition **retag** write side (today `retag` only reports — see [Usage](usage.qmd#retag))
- [ ] Homebrew tap
- [ ] Hosted UI

## Contributing

The matching/write engine is source-agnostic, so the highest-leverage contribution is a new
vendor — see [Adding a source](adding-a-source.qmd). Issues and PRs welcome on
[GitHub](https://github.com/drmowinckels/storywell).
